description: This file defines an OpenIdConnect security class for FastAPI, providing a stub implementation for OpenID Connect authentication, including dependencies setup, error handling, and request authorization logic.

classes.name: OpenIdConnect
classes.description: OpenID Connect authentication class intended for use as a dependency in FastAPI, providing a stub that links components with OpenAPI but requiring subclassing for full implementation.

methods.name: HTTPException make_not_authenticated_error(self)
methods.description: Creates an HTTP 401 Unauthorized exception indicating missing or invalid authentication.

methods.name: Optional[str] __call__(self, request: Request)
methods.description: Async method that checks for the Authorization header in the request and either returns the token or raises an error based on the auto_error flag.

methods.name:
__init__( self, *, openIdConnectUrl: Annotated[ str, Doc( "
            The OpenID Connect URL.
            " ), ], scheme_name: Annotated[ Optional[str], Doc( "
                Security scheme name.

                It will be included in the generated OpenAPI (e.g. visible at `/docs`).
                " ), ] = None, description: Annotated[ Optional[str], Doc( "
                Security scheme description.

                It will be included in the generated OpenAPI (e.g. visible at `/docs`).
                " ), ] = None, auto_error: Annotated[ bool, Doc( "
                By default, if no HTTP Authorization header is provided, required for
                OpenID Connect authentication, it will automatically cancel the request
                and send the client an error.

                If `auto_error` is set to `False`, when the HTTP Authorization header
                is not available, instead of erroring out, the dependency result will
                be `None`.

                This is useful when you want to have optional authentication.

                It is also useful when you want to have authentication that can be
                provided in one of multiple optional ways (for example, with OpenID
                Connect or in a cookie).
                " ), ] = True, )
